blocked_items.title: U.S. CISA adds an MLflow flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
rejection_reasons: RULE5: Confidence inflation detected. Stored=90% vs Formula-derived=22% (drift=68)
RULE8: Downgraded from PREMIUM_CTI: confidence=22% (<70 required); source_count=1 (<2 required); verified_sources=0 (<2 required); ioc_count=0 (must be >0); evidence_strength=LOW (<MEDIUM required)
required_remediation: evidence_ledger was missing — auto-generated from available fields. Add explicit evidence_ledger in report generator for production.
Recalculate confidence using formula. Derived=22%. Do not publish confidence=90% without evidence supporting it.

Add required API fields: ['evidence_ledger', 'confidence_reason', 'source_reliability', 'verification_status', 'attribution_status', 'ioc_quality', 'ttp_quality', 'report_quality']. These are mandatory for enterprise and MSSP consumers.
